changelog: Jhacker Terminal 1.0.3: fixed Google sign-in inside the v0 WebView (intent:// URLs no longer show ERR_UNKNOWN_URL_SCHEME — they now open as external intents, falling back to the browser URL when nothing handles them; tel: and mailto: links work the same way).

Jhacker Terminal 1.0.2: v0.app opens inside the app — a new 'v0 — AI App Builder' entry in the switcher and page overview opens Vercel v0 in the built-in browser (log in with your own Vercel account; no API key needed).

Jhacker Terminal 1.0.1: remaining AntiGem/AntiTerm display names renamed to Jhacker Terminal / JhackerTerm (launcher, setup, settings, plugin headers and descriptions); skull watermark added to the chat background.
Jhacker Terminal 1.0: AntiGem 2.0.4 fork, renamed to Jhacker Terminal with a new skull launcher icon. No functional changes.
